name: F3 波动扩张过滤 · 通道突破
notes: 动量腿而非回复腿。只在波动率正在上升且成交量放大时才认突破，其余时间完全不交易。假设：突破的假信号集中在缩量、波动收敛的时段。

signals.longEntry: close > ref(highest(high, chan), 1) and natr(14) > ref(natr(14), volRise) and volume > sma(volume, chan) * volMult
signals.longExit: close < ref(lowest(low, chan), 1) or close < sma(close, chan)
signals.shortEntry: close < ref(lowest(low, chan), 1) and natr(14) > ref(natr(14), volRise) and volume > sma(volume, chan) * volMult
signals.shortExit: close > ref(highest(high, chan), 1) or close > sma(close, chan)
